svg.text: GPGPU Virtual Machine + Algebraic Layout - Low-Precision LLM Serving - ASPLOS 2026 - github.com/NVIDIA/tilus
L1 - Applications + Integration (LLM serving with arbitrary low-precision quant matmul)
L2 - Python DSL Frontend (thread-block-level VM program - explicit memory hierarchy)
for/if/while retained - not lowered to jumps
Unlike Triton: full mem hierarchy exposed
Inspired by Triton tile model + Hexcute layout
L3 - VM IR (GPGPU virtual machine program - block-level instruction set)
L4 - Three Core VM Subsystems (layout algebra - memory hierarchy - low-precision pipeline)
f(t,i) maps thread + local idx to logical idx
Composition f o g - associative - not commutative
Layout division h/g - inverse of composition
Global mem: tensor views with offset + shape
Registers: distributed register tensors per warp
Compact sub-byte storage in uint8 arrays
Preprocess: change global layout for coalesced load
Vectorized Cast: PRMT + LOP3 + bitwise on CUDA
Fallback: bitwise AND/SHIFT/OR for arbitrary bits
4 Vectorized Cast to f16/bf16 for Tensor Core
L5 - Compiler Pipeline (DSL to VM IR - optimize - Hidet IR - CUDA C - nvcc binary)
Parse Python kernel - build VM program IR
VM IR lowered to Hidet IR (CUDA C-like)
Section 6 transforms: sub-byte to std types
~1 min compile - kernel cache per signature
L6 - Hidet Backend + Runtime (CUDA C codegen - nvcc - dynamic binary load - PyTorch integration)
Hidet IR to CUDA C to PTX to SASS binary
Tensor Core mma - cp.async - PRMT intrinsics
torch tensor I/O - custom quant matmul ops
Direct pipelining + mem control in VM
L7 - Target Hardware (NVIDIA Ampere primary - Hopper/Blackwell roadmap - Tensor Cores)
Python DSL - VM IR - optimize - Hidet IR - CUDA C - nvcc - cached binary launch
Stage 1 Parse: Python kernel to GPGPU VM program (grid, params, block-level instructions)
Stage 2 Layout+Mem: algebraic layout bind - register/shared/global tensor allocation
Stage 3 Optimize: IR passes - low-precision layout preprocess - cast lowering plan
Stage 4 Codegen: VM IR to Hidet IR to CUDA C with PRMT/LOP3/mma intrinsics
Stage 5 Launch: nvcc compile - autotune tile sizes (~200 configs) - cache - run on GPU
Example: FP16 x INT6 GEMM - BlockIndices - LoadGlobal(A) - AsyncCopy+Reinterpret+Cast(B) - MMA accumulate
Design Position: GPGPU VM above Triton, below CUDA
Procedure-oriented VM with explicit mem hierarchy - native 1-8 bit types - Hidet backend
Performance vs Baselines (quant matmul on L40S)
Full spectrum u1-u8 / i2-i8 / f3-f8 from one parameterized VM program template
Design Position (NVIDIA GPGPU VM for low-precision LLM serving - between Triton and hand-crafted kernels)
Thread-block VM + algebraic layout + explicit mem hierarchy - Hidet IR backend - arbitrary 1-8 bit quant
Init: pip install tilus - write @tilus kernel - autotune tile sizes - integrate into vLLM for decode/prefill serving
Sources: github.com/NVIDIA/tilus - arXiv:2504.12984 - ASPLOS 2026 - hidet 0.6.1 - Apache-2.0 - Toronto/NVIDIA research
